summary: Take the first-seen modal color as background and remove non-background corner markers. Merge same-color 8-connected pieces whose union fits a 5x5 motif. In every multi-color motif, treat the most frequent color as body and the least frequent color as core, then swap body and core. An off-center motif can inherit the body color of a congruent centered same-core twin. Finally, stamp every motif at the corner whose marker matches its core; if the motif encloses a hole, stamp only the loop bounding that hole.
